summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of 5 Instrum Studio fixes: page split (Beat Maker/Vocals & Audio tabs with prev/next arrows), header toolbar layout (File/Info/Fullscreen inline), Beat Maker controls (play/stop, BPM, undo/redo, tools, presets, grid), Vocals & Audio page (add track, FX panel, FX presets, FX Mix slider, controls), audio leak on exit (critical - playback stops when navigating away), and light mode Now Playing lyric popover styling (critical - dark background with white text for legibility). All 6 test scenarios PASSED successfully.
